intro.title: DocumentAI
intro.subtitle: An open-source, configurable document processing service

segments.text: DocumentAI is an open-source, configurable document processing service that evaluates and extracts structured information from uploaded documents. It can help determine whether a document is processable, readable, complete and consistent with configured document requirements.
Here, we upload a synthetic paystub. DocumentAI evaluates the file, extracting information from the document in a consistent, structured format.
Extracted values link back to their associated bounding box in the source document. Every value has a confidence score, and lower scores, like the employee ID, appear in red.
Administrators can define which fields are required for each document type. Here, employee ID, gross pay and pay period are required, while the rest are optional.
Operational metrics show volume, outcomes and processing time, providing insight into how the system is performing.
What would *your* agency need to configure, understand or measure before trying DocumentAI?
